maker: tmsuk Co., Ltd. with Kajima Corporation
variant: 6 robots: hanging bolt, 3 × T-bar assembly, secondary T-bar, ceiling board
name: tmsuk / Kajima suspended ceiling swarm robots
summary: Team of six small mobile robots that build suspended office ceilings together: one installs the hanging bolts, three assemble the long T-bars, one adds the short T-bars and one lays the ceiling boards into the grid. Developed by the Kyoto robot maker tmsuk with the contractor Kajima and tested on Kajima office sites.

germany.statusNote: Prototype system for Kajima's own sites in Japan; no sale or rental route found.

specs.label: Robots in the system
specs.conditions: 1 hanging bolt robot, 3 T-bar assembly robots, 1 secondary T-bar robot, 1 ceiling board robot

specs.label: Coordination
specs.value: edge AI on each robot, swarm task sharing
specs.quote: Each robot is equipped with edge-based artificial intelligence, allowing for real-time task coordination and environmental awareness.

specs.label: Transport
specs.quote: Robots can be transported via standard elevators and deployed selectively based on construction needs.

specs.label: Positioning
specs.quote: Each unit moves on a motorized platform capable of millimeter-level adjustments

notes: Drive type is not stated ('motorized platform'); wheels assumed. Lifting and fixing mechanisms are not described.
The hanging bolt robot detects obstructions such as beams or ducts and adjusts bolt positions; the board robot uses sensors to detect obstacles and fine-tune board placement.
Humans still do edge work and some steps of the process (maker footnote). Reduces scaffolding in the work zone.

Grid is a T-bar system ceiling with ceiling boards, not a screwed plasterboard ceiling. In June 2026 Kajima reported a separate automatic ceiling finishing robot run from a tablet; whether it belongs to this system is not stated.
